name: Compagnie Financiere Richemont SA
guidance_fy: No formal numeric revenue/EPS guidance issued (Richemont does not give quantitative guidance). Management commentary at FY26 results (22 May 2026) struck a confident tone on continued momentum (Q4 +13% cc) while flagging macro/geopolitical and China risks; proposed 10% higher ordinary dividend (CHF 3.30) plus CHF 1.00 special dividend signals confidence.
notes:
PRIMARY SOURCE: Richemont FY26 press release (year ended 31 Mar 2026, published 22 May 2026). Group sales EUR 22,420M (+11% constant FX / +5% actual), all business areas/regions/channels growing. Operating profit EUR 4,492M, op margin 20.0%. Profit for the year EUR 3,484M (vs EUR 2,800M prior). Diluted IFRS EPS EUR 5.909. CFO EUR 4,880M. Net cash position EUR 8,496M (+3% YoY) — fortress balance sheet, NO net debt. By Maison: Jewellery Maisons EUR 16.5B (+14% cc, 30.5% margin); Specialist Watchmakers EUR 3.1B (+1% cc, only 3.4% margin — weak watch division); Other EUR 2.7B (+3% cc, -EUR 96M loss). Q4 (Jan-Mar 2026) sales +13% cc, strong momentum.

REPORTING CADENCE: Richemont reports SEMI-ANNUALLY (H1 to Sep, FY to Mar) with quarterly SALES-only updates — there is NO quarterly P&L, so last_q op_margin/EPS are null/n.d. by design; only Q4 sales growth (+13% cc) is available.

EPS: Richemont reports under IFRS with no separate non-GAAP/adjusted EPS — eps_gaap = eps_adj = EUR 5.909 (diluted, FY26 full year). Per-quarter EPS not disclosed.

VALUATION (ESTIMATED, from StockAnalysis.com 22-Jun-2026): fwd P/E 28.2x, trailing P/E 33.6x, PEG 2.17. fwd_pe_5y_avg (~22.5x) and pe_prem_disc_pct (~+25%) are MODELED estimates — not from a primary feed; treat with caution. Stock screens RICH vs its own history and vs broader European luxury (~19x), roughly in line with megacap luxury peers.

FX: USD/CHF ~0.808 (1 CHF~1.238 USD), EUR/USD ~1.14 as of 22-Jun-2026. Market cap CHF 107.25B -> ~USD 132.8B. Net cash EUR 8,496M -> ~USD 9.7B (net_debt_usd_b=-9.7). nd_ebitda ~-1.5x is an APPROXIMATION (net cash / est EBITDA ~EUR 5.5-6B); company is net cash so leverage metric is informational only.

FCF: CFO EUR 4,880M is VERIFIED; FCF (~EUR 3.8B) and FCF margin (~17%) are ESTIMATES — capex not extracted within timebox.

SBC (CRITICAL for R9): Could NOT extract exact share-based payment figure from FY26 Annual Report within timebox -> sbc_pct_revenue and sbc_pct_fcf left null. STRUCTURAL NOTE: Richemont is a Swiss family-controlled luxury group (Rupert family via 'B' shares) that uses minimal equity compensation; share-based payment is a small non-cash line historically well under ~1% of revenue. SBC dilution risk is LOW — unlike US tech this is not a concern for R9, but the precise % should be confirmed from the FY26 Accounts (share-based payment note) before finalizing.

DROP CLASSIFICATION = not_depressed: Stock at CHF 182.30, only ~1.5% below 52-week high of CHF 185.10, +23% over trailing 12 months, trading near all-time highs after RECORD FY26 results. NOT a fallen/fear-driven name — a strong-momentum, full-valuation luxury leader. Only soft spot is Specialist Watchmakers (3.4% margin), but group results and share price are at highs. pct_off_ath (~-1.8%) is approximate (ATH ~CHF 185-186 area).

ROIC: not disclosed directly in press release; left null (high-margin Jewellery Maisons + net-cash balance sheet imply strong returns, but no verified figure).
